conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces your exposure to market swings by cutting all leveraged ETFs. Expect lower drawdowns but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to cure the concentration breach.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% monthly growth by blending broad index exposure with quality tech and a small, managed allocation to leveraged ETFs. It reduces overall concentration and introduces a new high-potential setup. Expect moderate drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to cure the concentration breach.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by significantly increasing exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware that this strategy amplifies both upside and drawdown potential. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lead to substantial losses quickly if not managed with strict stop discipline.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% monthly distributions by rotating into income-focused ETFs and broad index exposure.
